meaning.hi: न साधक-इच्छुक, न मुक्त, यही परम सत्य है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the self is one, understood across waking, dream, sleep
meaning.hi: स्वयं एक है, जाग्रत, स्वप्न, नींद भर में

meaning.en: for one beyond the three states, no rebirth exists
meaning.hi: तीन अवस्थाओं से परे के लिए पुनर्जन्म नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: eka eva hi bhutatma bhute-bhute vyavasthitah

meaning.en: one self alone dwells in every being
meaning.hi: एक स्वयं ही हर प्राणी में स्थित है

words.sanskrit: ekadha bahudha ca eva drshyate jalacandravat

meaning.en: seen as one and many, like the moon in water
meaning.hi: एक और कई रूप में दिखता, जल-चंद्र की तरह

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the space enclosed in a pot, when the pot is moved
meaning.hi: बर्तन में घिरा आकाश, बर्तन ले जाए जाने पर

meaning.en: the living self is comparable to the sky
meaning.hi: जीवात्मा आकाश के समान है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: like a pot repeatedly breaking into many forms
meaning.hi: बर्तन की तरह बार-बार कई रूपों में टूटता

words.sanskrit: tadbhede ca na janati sah janati ca nityashah

meaning.en: it doesn't know that division, it knows itself as eternally same
meaning.hi: यह उस भेद को नहीं जानता, यह स्वयं को शाश्वत जानता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: as long as covered by sound's illusion, appears abundant
meaning.hi: जब तक ध्वनि-माया से ढका, प्रचुर प्रतीत होता है

words.sanskrit: bhinne tamasi ekatvam eka eva anupashyati

meaning.en: once darkness is broken, one sees oneness alone
meaning.hi: अंधकार टूटने पर, व्यक्ति अकेली एकता देखता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: shabdarnam aparam brahma tasmin kshine yat aksharam

meaning.en: sound-Brahman is other; once exhausted, the imperishable remains
meaning.hi: शब्द-ब्रह्म अन्य है; क्षीण होने पर अक्षय शेष रहता है

words.sanskrit: tad vidvan aksharam dhyayet shantim atmanah

meaning.en: the knower meditates on the imperishable, for the self's peace
meaning.hi: ज्ञानी अक्षय पर ध्यान करे, आत्मा की शांति के लिए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: dve brahmani hi mantavye shabdabrahma param ca yat

meaning.en: two Brahmans to be known, sound-Brahman and the supreme
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म के दो रूप जानने योग्य, शब्द-ब्रह्म और परम

meaning.en: proficient in sound-Brahman, one reaches supreme Brahman
meaning.hi: शब्द-ब्रह्म में निपुण, परम ब्रह्म तक पहुँचता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: having studied the text, devoted to knowledge and realization
meaning.hi: ग्रंथ का अध्ययन कर, ज्ञान-साक्षात्कार में समर्पित

meaning.en: like one seeking grain discards the husk, discard the text entirely
meaning.hi: जैसे अनाज-खोजी भूसी त्यागे, ग्रंथ पूरी तरह त्यागे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: cows of many colours, yet milk is one colour
meaning.hi: कई रंगों की गायें, फिर भी दूध एक रंग का

words.sanskrit: kshiravat pashyati jnani lingina tu gavam yatha

meaning.en: the wise see like milk, others see only the cow's markings
meaning.hi: बुद्धिमान दूध की तरह देखते, बाकी केवल गाय के चिह्न

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: fixing the eye of knowledge on the great supreme state
meaning.hi: ज्ञान की आँख को महान परम पद पर जमाकर

words.sanskrit: nishkalam nishcalam shantam brahma aham iti samsmaret

meaning.en: formless, unmoving, peaceful, remember I am Brahman
meaning.hi: निराकार, अचल, शांत, मैं ब्रह्म हूँ स्मरण करे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: knowing the supreme Brahman-form, dwelling in all beings, turiya
meaning.hi: परम ब्रह्म-रूप, सभी प्राणियों में निवासी, तुरीय को जानना

words.sanskrit: akashat eva sarvani bhutani jayante akasha eva liyante

meaning.en: all beings are born from space and dissolve into space
meaning.hi: सभी प्राणी आकाश से जन्मते और आकाश में घुलते हैं

meaning.en: divided elevenfold, yet one indivisible syllable of Brahman
meaning.hi: ग्यारह भागों में बँटा, फिर भी एक अविभाज्य ब्रह्म-अक्षर
